SG01.text: Learn the key terms: Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Extended Reality (XR), and Mixed Reality (MR)

SG02.text: Explore the meanings, differences, and significance of XR, AR, and VR

SG03.text: Explore common perceptions of AR/VR/XR using examples like games, Avatar, and internal views

SG04.text: Understand XR as an umbrella term for all immersive technologies (AR, VR, MR)

SG05.text: Learn the reality-virtuality continuum and the difference between augmented reality and augmented virtuality

SG06.text: See the growth potential of XR using market statistics and the metaverse concept

SG07.text: See the course structure, covering basic concepts, theory, and development using a case study

SG08.text: See the course scope, including the digital heritage project and foundational concepts

HG1.01.text: Understand the definitions and differences between VR, AR, MR, and XR

HG1.02.text: See XR's growth potential and what the course covers, including the digital heritage project

TOP.text: Understand XR concepts, their differences, and the course structure
